source.implements: what Remove and Update take off the phone for one kept list: the kept export, the list, its out-of-date row, its per-battle ticks (wh-used-<id>), its Phase checklist boxes (wh-check-<id>), its Strategic reserves boxes (wh-res-<id>) and its star

20.01 Placing Units in Strategic Reserves, read from data.js RULES: the step ("Before the battle, in the Declare Battle Formations step"), the units excluded ("(excluding **FORTIFICATIONS**)": the keyword, singular), the limit sentence and its percentage ("cannot exceed 50% of your points limit for your battle size"); none of them typed by hand, null where the words say none

note: The limit is read from data.js RULES Strategic Reserves (GW Core Rules 20.01, PDF p68, verify/texts.js: found word for word): "Unless otherwise stated, the combined points value of all of your strategic reserves units (including those embarked within TRANSPORTS that are themselves placed in strategic reserves) cannot exceed 50% of your points limit for your battle size." 50% of 2000 (Strike Force) = 1000 pts, the friend's 1k. No unit-count limit in GW's text, so none is checked. Not added: 23.01 (AIRCRAFT must be placed in strategic reserves) and the Event Companion's Redeploy Units step (units placed in reserves then do not count): no list has an AIRCRAFT unit, the owner asked to keep the screen simple.

source.implements: GRANTS rows that give a unit a rule (Deep Strike): an army rule of its faction or a detachment rule of the list (by the rule's name in the row) to units whose keywords its to names; or a usable ability of the unit (an enhancement too) of the row's name whose words contain the row's text, to this unit / model; by words, not list id, so an imported list finds them

note: Thunderhawk Insertion (nerf-when, Marneus Calgar): GRANTS has to:"this unit / model", but GW's words are "select one friendly GRAVIS/PHOBOS/TACTICUS unit. That unit has Deep Strike." The screen follows GRANTS (the mark is on Calgar's unit, with GW's words quoted); a GRANTS reading to check. Umbralefic Crystal / Mysterious Guardian give Deep Strike only "until the start of your next Shooting phase" (in battle): shown, with those words quoted. An imported list finds a grant only where GRANTS has a row for that ability's words (GRANTS is written from the built-in lists).

source.implements: 24.09 Deep Strike ("if every model in this unit has this ability"): own when the unit's Rules line (unitRules) has it and no model alone has it (partialRules); part (which model) when one model alone has it; plus every GRANTS row that gives it (resGrants)

note: Same reading as the Overview's Deep Strike row (every model: partialRules), plus GRANTS; checked by verify/render.js reserves-ds against data.js independently (mutation: grants:[] fails on pubstomper and simple-but-effective).

judgement.code: const resBoxes = u => Array.from({ length:u.copies || 1 }, (_, i) => u.id + ((u.copies || 1) > 1 ? '#' + i : ''));

source.implements: one reserves box per unit, one per copy of a ×N unit (u.id, u.id#i)

the running total: each ticked box counts its unit's points (u.pts, as the list prints them; an attached unit's whole), excluded units (resRule excl) never; the limit is floor(the list's points limit × GW's percentage / 100): 1000 pts at Strike Force 2000

note: Counts u.pts per ticked box: an attached unit is one box at its whole points (the list's entry); embarked units are ticked by the player (GW's sentence includes them).

source.implements: the total pinned under the top bar: points in reserves / the limit, the units ticked, and the points left or, over the limit, how far over (in the bad-news colour)

Strategic reserves: the pinned total (resBar), the step and GW's limit sentence quoted with a link to the rule, every unit of the list in list order with a box per copy (excluded units: box disabled, marked "<KEYWORD>: excluded" linking the rule), its points, and its Deep Strike marks (own, one model only, or a grant: the rule or ability that gives it, linked, with the row's words quoted); boxes kept per list (wh-res-<id>), Reset clears them (with Undo)
